verdict.rationale: The only evidence of programmatic dashboard creation is the hosted MCP server's Create-Dashboard tool, which builds dashboards with text cards and reports through an AI-assistant interface rather than a conventional REST API. The Query API only returns calculated report results and does not create or manage saved reports. Missing for 10: a documented REST endpoint for dashboard create/update/delete, programmatic creation or management of saved insights/reports, an OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
